metadata.description: EODHD daily prices for the full point-in-time S&P 500 (#386): 753 LSEG RICs, 503 to 509 members a weekday from 2016-01-04 to 2026-07-31. Membership is the LSEG intervals file of the r1 110-name package, rows unchanged under the kdcode header.

producing_arguments: EODHD daily prices for the full point-in-time S&P 500 (#386): 753 LSEG RICs, 503 to 509 members a weekday from 2016-01-04 to 2026-07-31. Membership is the LSEG intervals file of the r1 110-name package, rows unchanged under the kdcode header.
unknowns: DD.N^I17: no EODHD price history; absent from the panel (EODHD holds no history for the pre-merger DuPont common stock. Its DD.US rows before 2017-09-01 are The Dow Chemical Company's (the same closes as DOW_old.US, e.g. 45.59 on 2015-01-02), and its US listings carry only DuPont preferred shares (CTA-PA, CTA-PB, DD-PA, DD-PB). Found in the first EODHD pull of 2026-10-08; the name is absent from the panel. A data config using the package declares it in data.pit_absent_kdcodes, and admission then keeps it off the stock axis.)
IILGV.OQ^E16: no EODHD price history; absent from the panel (EODHD lists no IILGV symbol: when-issued lines are not carried.)

JCI.N^I16: no EODHD price history; absent from the panel (EODHD holds no series for the pre-merger Johnson Controls Inc.: its JCI.US before 2016-09-02 is Tyco's (31.79 on 2016-01-04, the same close as TYC.US), and no other listing carries the name. LSEG's monthly market cap for this RIC is Tyco's too.)
